Original Link: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/llcXE2be4oNWItL_0ydVZw  
The 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (IEEE ICRA 2026), a top-tier academic event in robotics and automation, will be held from June 1 to 5 in Vienna, Austria. This year, several papers from Chinese teams, including FP3 and HITTER, have been nominated for Best Paper Awards. Leading Tech previously reported on HITTER; today, we look at another study, FP3.  
One of FP3's paper advisors, Gao Yang, is an assistant professor at Tsinghua University's Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences (IIIS) and also a co-founder and chief scientist of the domestic embodied intelligence unicorn Spirit AI.  
Below, let's explore the innovations of FP3.  
Improvements from a 3D Foundation  
Foundation models pre-trained on massive multi-task data show great potential in robotics, but most basic robot policy models only use 2D images as input observations, lacking 3D geometric information—crucial for robots to perceive and understand real 3D space.  
In summary, FP3 is a large-scale 3D foundation policy model for robotic manipulation.  
With 1.3B parameters, it is built on a scalable diffusion Transformer architecture, pre-trained on 60,000 motion trajectories with point cloud observations, leveraging its unique modality.

Author | Wu You    Editor | Liu Wei  

"Smart rings are still a niche market globally, with annual sales of a few million units, but I believe they will eventually catch up with smartwatches and achieve global sales of hundreds of millions." Professor Wang Guoxing, a distinguished professor at Shanghai Jiao Tong University and founder of the RingConn brand, shared his outlook on the future of smart rings on May 30 at the INNO100 Global Innovation Flagship Store in Shenzhen.  

That day marked the product launch of the RingConn Gen3. Professor Wang, dressed in a light green shirt and wearing three smart rings, attended the event to introduce the new-generation AI smart ring to tech enthusiasts and users.  

Compared to the Gen2, the Gen3 focuses on three key upgrades:  

First, long-term blood pressure trend insights, enabled by clinically validated automatic monitoring every 15 minutes to reflect real vascular load. It also provides comprehensive vascular health analysis and personalized improvements based on load factors such as sleep, exercise, circadian rhythm, and daily vascular stability.  

Second, the industry's first micro-awakening recognition, capable of detecting brief, unnoticed awakenings during sleep, offering a more accurate reflection of fatigue and sleep quality.  

Third, the addition of AI-powered health vibration alerts, supporting proactive interventions in scenarios such as abnormal heart rate, prolonged sitting, high stress, headaches, fever, and dehydration.  

Additionally, the Gen3 features a parallel stacked architecture with seven sensors and a VCSEL infrared solution, utilizing a patented ergonomic design with a round inner structure and square outer shape.

In June 2026, the Beijing Zhiyuan Conference will commence. For attendees of large academic conferences, the dense schedule of parallel forums, overlapping major topics, and limited opportunities for expert interaction often create a dilemma of "too much to hear, too little time to attend, and no chance to ask follow-ups." Addressing this high-density knowledge scenario, Zhiyuan will officially launch a personal exclusive intelligent agent, SoulAgent, offering attendees a brand-new intelligent conference experience.
